messages.subject: Two frozen quirks found by DIFFERENTIAL TESTING, not by reading the source

H-06.behaviour: normalizeItems([null]) throws TypeError: Cannot use 'in' operator to search for 'json' in null
H-06.cause: typeof null === 'object' passes the guard, so the 'json' in item probe runs on null
H-06.impact: any node helper that forwards a null member crashes before the Inconsistent item format check can fire

H-07.behaviour: the itemData argument LOSES to an item that already carries pairedItem
H-07.cause: only json is destructured out, so ...rest still holds the item's own pairedItem and is spread LAST, overwriting the value written one line earlier
H-07.impact: callers that intend to stamp metadata must strip pairedItem first; the helper does not do it for them

payload.note: Both are pinned by unit tests AND by the A/B parity suite; mutation M2 proves the suite rejects the intuitive reading.
